releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.178: Diary PIN Tala now opens the same Diary Lock Settings after PIN setup/change, so Pattern, PIN and Fingerprint options can be configured through either entry path. Existing Note Lock, PIN recovery, saved data, reminders, package identity and signing identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
